name: Red Band Title
tagline: Anime-opening title: hard slams, a spinning sunburst and an RGB-split title that lands on a skewed red band.
description: Anime-opening title style for launches, series intros and brand names. Charcoal, crimson and off-white, a giant word or glyph slamming onto a vignetted cream card with a shake, then a dark sunburst where the title drops in letter by letter with a red/cyan chromatic split, a skewed crimson band slides in behind it, and small letterspaced corner labels lock it up. The preview opens on a kanji.

body.usage: Opening English word 230px; subline 42px tracking 0.34em; corner labels 22px tracking 0.24em

transitions: hard cuts: dark word card → cream glyph card → dark sunburst
glitch hit: band and split layers jump 14–22px then settle
textAnimations: per-character drop with back.out, 80ms apart, on all three layers
red and cyan copies start offset ±18px and converge (chromatic aberration)
opening word widens (scaleX 1 → 1.12) after its slam
subline rises under the band, a white rule draws beneath

rhythm.notes: Two very short hits (~0.8s each) then one long title hold. Band lands ~1.4s after the title starts; one glitch hit near the end.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Charcoal #1b1b1d, crimson #e5173f and off-white #f7f5f2 only; red #ff2a55 and cyan #27e3ff appear just as chromatic split layers. Hit cards are cream with a vignette (radial #f4f3ee → #e4e2da → #9e9c94) and ink #141414 type.
- Open with very short hard-cut hits (~0.8s each): one huge word or glyph per card (Oswald 700 uppercase 230px, or Dela Gothic One up to 560px) that slams from scale 2.1 with power4.in, then a camera shake (6 × 40ms jitter). A slammed word can widen scaleX 1 → 1.12 after impact.
- Build the title as three stacked layers (red, cyan, white) of the same spans in Dela Gothic One ~180px; drop characters by index across all layers with back.out(2.5), 80ms apart, and converge the red/cyan offsets from ±18px to 0 with power2.out.
- The band is a full-width crimson bar (~290px tall), skewY -4° and rotated -2°, sliding in behind the title with power4.out about 1.4s after the title starts. Dim the sunburst to ~35% when it lands.
- Keep a slowly rotating (linear) repeating-conic sunburst behind the title: crimson at 22% opacity, 4° rays with 8° gaps on charcoal.
- Lock up with an Oswald 500 subline (42px, tracking 0.34em) rising under the band, a thin white rule drawing beneath, and tiny 22px corner labels tracked 0.24em in #bdbab3.
- One glitch hit near the end: the band and split layers jump 14–22px, then settle. Pacing is two quick hits, then one long title hold.
- Optional motif: a single kanji or other bold glyph that echoes the subject as one of the opening hits. Avoid gradients beyond the sunburst, soft fades and extra colours.
example: The preview is an anime-style opener for a slide-deck tool: the word SLIDES slams in, a giant 新 crashes onto a cream card, then a Japanese title drops in with red/cyan split onto a skewed crimson band. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
